	                    <article class="post-249 page type-page status-publish has-post-thumbnail hentry" id="post-249">
							<div class="entry-content">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"> Beachside bures </h2>
<div class="mk-separator"></div>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Namotu Island is a boutique resort with 12 rooms offering a unique range of comfortable and private accommodation options for couples, singles and even families. All rooms have private bathroom and balcony, WiFi, ocean views, air conditioning and direct beach access. </p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">We have two classes of rooms, standard and premium. All rooms are studio apartments and have one open-plan bedroom. </p>
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="1061" height="1110" src="https://www.namotuislandfiji.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Namotu-accommodation-map-1061x1110.png" alt="" class="wp-image-222459" srcset="https://www.namotuislandfiji.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Namotu-accommodation-map-1061x1110.png 1061w, https://www.namotuislandfiji.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Namotu-accommodation-map-287x300.png 287w, https://www.namotuislandfiji.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Namotu-accommodation-map-768x804.png 768w, https://www.namotuislandfiji.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Namotu-accommodation-map-551x576.png 551w, https://www.namotuislandfiji.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Namotu-accommodation-map-789x825.png 789w, https://www.namotuislandfiji.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Namotu-accommodation-map.png 1426w" sizes="(max-width: 1061px) 100vw, 1061px" /></figure>
